day_shape: 78 items: Iran's Foreign Ministry says no nuclear talks underway and the alleged 14-point text not yet sent, Netanyahu confirms IDF 36th Division crossed the Litani, CENTCOM reports 115 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, UK charges Greek national over alleged Iranian plot against Iran International journalist.

threads.label: Iran-US negotiations and nuclear messaging
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson said agreement is not finalised, no nuclear negotiations are underway at this stage, and the alleged 14-point text has not been sent to Washington. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf said Iran obtains concessions through missiles not talks, while IRNA dismissed Trump's statements on enriched material and frozen assets.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and oil blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said 115 commercial vessels have been redirected under the Iran blockade as of 29 May, while the IRGC Navy claimed 24 ships transited Hormuz in 24 hours with Iranian permission. Foreign Minister Araghchi held a call with Oman's Badr Al-Busaidi on Hormuz management; Tanker Trackers observed a VLCC loading two million barrels off Iran's coast.

threads.label: Lebanon front and IDF Litani crossing
threads.summary: Netanyahu confirmed the IDF 36th Division crossed the Litani River and advanced into southern Lebanon, with IDF Arabic spokesperson Adraee issuing evacuation warnings for Zafta, Ansariya, Ain Qana and other villages. Israeli and Lebanese military officials are reportedly set to meet at the Pentagon on Friday; Hezbollah claimed four operations including a Merkava tank strike.

threads.label: Gaza operations and Hamas commander killed
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed killing Imad Hassan Hussein Aslim, deputy commander of Hamas's Gaza City Brigade and Zeitoun Battalion commander, in a Wednesday strike, plus four Hamas gunmen in additional strikes. The IDF also said Hamas is now operating fibre-optic drones in Gaza similar to Hezbollah's.

threads.label: Iranian transnational repression cases
threads.summary: UK police charged a Greek national with assisting Iranian intelligence over targeting of an Iran International journalist, and a US court sentenced Jonathan Loadholt to 10 years for a murder-for-hire plot against an Iranian-born journalist. Germany arrested an alleged Danish Hamas member over a plot against Jewish and Israeli sites in Europe; Israeli researchers tied a March LA transit hack to an Iran-linked group.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and domestic unity
threads.summary: Khamenei's office urged devotees not to turn disagreements into division and circulated images and donation channels for a memorial assembly for martyrs of Imam Khomeini's and the Leader's families. Defa Press carried parliamentary commentary on adapting laws to public priorities and an Alawi flag ceremony in Tehran tied to 110 worldwide locations.

threads.label: Iran's regional and Eurasian diplomacy
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian highlighted Iran's role in the Eurasian Economic Union and SNSC deputy Ali Baghchi reported a three-day Moscow visit promoting a new security equation. IRGC commander Rezai vowed to break the siege through negotiations or direct action; Defa Press also claimed an MQ-9 drone was downed in Marib, Yemen.

events.title: Extension of Lebanon Designation for Temporary Protected Status
events.summary: The designation of Lebanon for Temporary Protected Status (TPS), which was set to expire on May 27, 2026, is automatically extended to November 27, 2026. Under the TPS statute, if the Secretary does not determine whether a foreign state continues to meet the conditions for designation for TPS at least 60 days before the expiration of the country's current TPS designation, the period of designation is automatically extended for six months. Rapidly unfolding events in Lebanon in March 2026 impacted the Department's ability to conduct a thorough review of prevailing country conditions for the Secretary's timely consideration and determination.
